name: app-69c29e815338819194c3a90700f46766
description: Live fixed prices for private airport transfers, quoted in the chat and booked on airporttaxihub.com.

interface.longDescription: Live, fixed prices for private airport transfers in the UK and 90+ markets: airport to hotel, address or city centre, one-way or return. Every price includes 60 minutes' free waiting after your flight lands, express pick-up at the airport's designated point, no meter and no surge, and free cancellation until 24 hours before pick-up. Compare vehicles from saloon to 16-seater, then finish the booking on airporttaxihub.com, where the flight number, exact address and any extras are added. Prices in chat are the same as on the website.
capabilities: Live fixed prices for airport transfers
Vehicles that fit the party and luggage
defaultPrompt: Taxi from Edinburgh Airport to The Balmoral hotel next Saturday at 9:30am, 2 of us with 2 suitcases. How much?
Return transfer from Heathrow to The Savoy, landing Friday at 08:00 and back Monday at 18:00, 2 people, 2 suitcases.
Cheapest way for 8 of us with 8 bags from Stansted Airport to Cambridge next month at noon.

positive.description: Direct airport-to-hotel request with every detail supplied; the hotel name is shared by hotels in different towns, so the app must never quote a same-named hotel elsewhere.
positive.prompt: I land at Edinburgh Airport next Saturday at 9:30am and need a taxi to The Balmoral hotel, 2 of us with 2 suitcases. How much?
positive.expected_behavior: No question comes before the price, because every detail is in the prompt. The app never quotes a same-named hotel elsewhere: it either asks which Balmoral is meant (the card lists the options as buttons, the Edinburgh one first), or, when the request it receives names Edinburgh, quotes The Balmoral, a Rocco Forte hotel, Princes Street, Edinburgh directly, naming the address on the card. Once the place is settled, the card shows a route map, the hotel's address under the route, and priced vehicles for 2 passengers and 2 suitcases (Saloon first, marked Recommended), a button to add a return journey, and a Book link to airporttaxihub.com at the same price.

positive.description: Indirect request with missing details: the app must ask for the landing time and suitcase count rather than assume them, then quote for the party size, hiding vehicles that cannot carry the party.
positive.prompt: We're flying into Gatwick next Friday evening, 3 adults and a toddler, staying somewhere near Tower Bridge. What's the best way to get there and what would it cost?
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT asks for the missing details (landing time, number of suitcases, the hotel or area) in one message and may also ask whether a return is needed; it does not invent them. Once answered, the app resolves Gatwick to London Gatwick Airport on its own and offers only the Tower Bridge places to choose from, then shows priced vehicles for 4 passengers with the 3-seat Saloon not offered and the People Carrier marked Recommended for more suitcase room. Book opens airporttaxihub.com on Transfer details with the chosen vehicle at the same price.

positive.description: Airport pick-up to a named city-centre hotel for one passenger: both places have one real answer, so the app quotes at once with no place question; then a return is added on the card itself, which prices both legs without a new chat message.
positive.prompt: Taxi from Manchester Airport to the Midland Hotel in Manchester next Tuesday at 2pm, just me and one suitcase.
positive.expected_behavior: The airport and the hotel resolve directly with no place question; the card names The Midland with its address, 16 Peter St, Manchester, under the route, and shows the vehicles from the Saloon upwards with a Book link. Using the card's "Add a return journey" button, choosing a return date and time and pressing "Get return prices" re-prices the same card: each vehicle shows the two one-way prices struck through, the return total and "Out / back / saves". A return less than 4 hours after the outbound pick-up is refused on the card with a warning under the time field and nothing is priced.

positive.description: Return journey: both legs are priced together and the round-trip discount is shown against the two one-way prices.
positive.prompt: Return transfer from Heathrow Airport to The Savoy hotel in London, landing two weeks from today at 08:00 and back to the airport three days later at 18:00, 2 people with 2 suitcases.
positive.expected_behavior: The app asks which Savoy is meant (the hotel or the nearby Savoy centenary memorial). After the user confirms The Savoy Hotel, Strand, the card shows the address under the route and each vehicle with the outbound price, the return price, the discounted total and the saving, and offers a Book link that opens the return booking on airporttaxihub.com.

positive.description: Large party: the vehicle set must reflect capacity, so only the minibus and 16-seater are offered for 8 passengers with 8 suitcases.
positive.prompt: Cheapest way for 8 of us with 8 bags from Stansted Airport to Cambridge a month from today at noon.
positive.expected_behavior: The app asks which Cambridge is meant, because the name is genuinely ambiguous (the options include a Cambridge railway station, Cambridge University, a London theatre and a Cambridge in Canada), and the user picks Cambridge, UK. The card then shows only vehicles that carry 8 passengers and 8 suitcases (Minibus, then 16-seater), cheapest first, with prices and a Book link. No vehicle is marked Recommended, because the Minibus would be full.

negative.description: Airport information question with no transfer to price; the app must not be called.
negative.prompt: Which terminal does British Airways use at Heathrow, and how early should I get there for a long-haul flight?

negative.description: Flight status is out of scope; the app prices transfers and does not track flights.
negative.prompt: Is my BA117 flight tomorrow delayed?

negative.description: On-demand ride hailing is out of scope; the app only prices pre-booked transfers with a date and time.
negative.prompt: Book me an Uber to Heathrow right now.
